name: Utopia
summary: Calculators that generate fluid type, space and grid scales as CSS, SCSS or PostCSS custom properties.
description: Free browser calculators for fluid responsive design: define type and space scales for a small and a large viewport and Utopia interpolates between them with clamp(), emitting CSS custom properties. A grid calculator and a generic clamp calculator cover spacing and layout; a blog explains designing with fluid scales.
contains: type, space, grid and clamp calculators
fluid scales interpolated with clamp() between min and max viewports
output as CSS, SCSS or PostCSS; REM or PX; viewport or container relative
articles on fluid responsive design and a showcase
